assets.name: Frame_Damage
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent Unity game UI sprite, frame ONLY. Image 1 is a style/geometry reference (01 Noble Diamond). Produce only the red diamond border shown around the flame in the top half: perfectly centered square rotated 45 degrees, tips at top/bottom/left/right, exactly symmetric. Narrow double antique metallic border, dark muted crimson enamel #A5403F inset strips, tiny ivory antique-gold diamond studs at the four tips. Very fine pixel-art metal highlights, old aristocratic dark fantasy not rough stone. Square canvas 1024x1024; complete frame including tip jewels fits bbox x64..959 y64..959; all four stud centers equally spaced from (512,512). No round ring, no flame, no icon, NO black fill, no text or number, no additional ornaments. Entire diamond interior AND exterior genuinely alpha transparent. No checkerboard painted into image. Match the reference's thin restrained border and joint scale, not a heavy or thick fantastical frame.

assets.name: Cooldown_Ring
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent Unity cooldown ring sprite. Image 1 is a style reference (01 Noble Diamond); focus only on the small circular cooldown sample at lower left-middle. Create ONE FULL 360-degree thin perfect circle, centered, warm ivory metal on transparent, continuous circular band WITHOUT gaps or separate ticks. Band thickness 12 pixels for a circle diameter 768 pixels within a 1024 square canvas. Pixel-art crisp edges, subtle ivory aged-silver beveled highlight, restrained dark fantasy UI. Exactly circular not oval, concentric edges. No progress numbers, no letters, no icons, no diamonds, no black disk, no background, no partial arc. Entire inside and outside alpha transparent. This complete circle will be partially revealed by Unity radial fill, do not bake a progress state.

assets.name: Bottom_Velvet
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent horizontal bottom HUD background for Unity. Image 1 reference = 01 Noble Diamond. Generate ONLY the single long velvet background shown on the bottom right of that reference, preserving its architecture: one wide raised FLAT CENTRAL PLATFORM occupying the central 60% of width, two identical short 45-degree diagonal shoulders sloping down toward lower flat side wings. Symmetric left/right, completely straight horizontal bottom edge. Width to height of actual panel approx 7.2:1. Center top platform height 210, wing height 115, panel width1500 in a1536x1024 transparent canvas, horizontally centered. Very dark burgundy velvet damask fills ALL panel interior, fine antique gold/ivory double metal perimeter trim, tiny corner filigree only at lower extreme sides, subtle pointed corner studs. No black subpanels dividing the velvet. Match reference's restrained noble pixel-art metal and dense very dark wine-red damask. Render full complete silhouette not cropped. Absolutely no skill slots, rings, flames, shields, icons, labels, numbers, top game grid, sample sheet, divider or UI buttons. Genuinely transparent alpha outside panel, no baked checkerboard or drop shadow. Burgundy low luminance, elegant aristocratic, not bright red, stone, dirt or rough material. The upper center is raised, NOT U shaped depressed center.
